spec.notes: Long names with improving news sentiment.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.1, annual return 3%, maximum drawdown 5%.

exhibits.summary: On the sealed period, traded as live (strict data, 10 bps, at least one bar of lag), the Sharpe ratio is -0.12 against 1.07 in research, a gap of +1.19.

charges.argument: The holdout test on sealed data shows a Sharpe ratio of -0.12, which is significantly lower than the research Sharpe ratio of 1.07, indicating overfitting of the strategy to the research period data.

rebuttals.argument: The holdout test shows a Sharpe ratio of -0.12 on sealed data, which is significantly lower than the research Sharpe ratio of 1.07. This indicates overfitting, as the strategy does not generalize well to unseen data.

verdict.opinion: The strategy's performance on sealed data (Sharpe -0.12) is significantly worse than the research period (Sharpe 1.07), indicating overfitting and potential lookahead bias. The strategy is not deployable with real capital.
